why: Health only goes down, so it is lowest at the very end: you need total damage minus the armor saving, plus 1. The armor saves min(armor, power[i]), so the greedy choice is the round where that saving is largest, which is the biggest power round.
hints: When during the game is health at its lowest?
At the end, after all damage. So start = sum(power) - saving + 1, and you want the saving as large as possible.
One pass: total += p and best = max(best, min(p, armor)). Answer total - best + 1. O(n), O(1).
pitfalls: The +1: health must stay strictly above 0.
Armor saves at most power[i] in that round; it cannot carry leftover protection, so use min(armor, p).
Sums reach 10^14; fine in Python, needs 64-bit elsewhere.
